subject: Request: Onramp credits + rate exception for Emerald Systems
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@emeraldsys.com>, procurement@emeraldsys.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot onramp — request for combined credits + rate carveout

Alice / Procurement team — thanks again for a productive demo last week. Emerald’s use case (large-scale summarization + secure embeddings) maps well to our dedicated runtime and the team is ready to move from PoC to a small onramp. 

Before we finalize the SOW, they asked for two concessions to make the POC frictionless:
- 3 months of additional trial credits ($25,000 of hosted credits up-front) to cover embedding indexing and initial traffic spikes
- A temporary rate carveout (40% off list for first 6 months on usage) in exchange for a 12-month commit at a tiered minimum (details below)

Why I’m asking: Emerald is willing to convert to a paid Dedicated plan after the onramp and has indicated an expected ARR of ~$1.2M over 12 months if performance and cost targets are met. The requested mix (credits + short-term rate concession) materially reduces early buyer friction and accelerates adoption.

Proposed gating terms:
- $25k one-time onramp credit applied to hosted usage; expires 90 days after activation
- 40% discount on token/embedding rates for first 6 months after activation
- Customer signs 12-month commitment at a blended monthly minimum of $16.6k (total $200k ARR) or agrees to a revenue share reconciliation if they fail to hit the minimum
- SLA: 99.9% availability for hosted inference; we will route to Dedicated upon conversion

Attachments: SOW-draft-v2.pdf (contains proposed language), pricing-matrix.csv (shows list vs. concessioned rates + impact).

Next step: Alice — if procurement is comfortable with the gating terms above, can you confirm and I’ll route for exec signoff? If we need to escalate, Marissa — can you greenlight this concession or propose changes?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0148

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@emeraldsys.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onramp — request for combined credits + rate carveout

Vanessa — thanks, this looks like a good framework. Procurement is generally comfortable with credits + a temporary rate concession if there’s a defined conversion path. Two quick clarifications from our side: 
1) Can the $25k credit be drawn down over 90 days but not displace the first month of committed spend? (we need to preserve the appearance of commitment for internal reporting)
2) We’d like a clause stating the discount applies only to the listed model family in the attached SOW (Embeddings-Large / GenX-2) — Emerald operates under strict cost modeling and we can’t accept open-ended discounts across the catalog.

If those two points are acceptable I can push this to legal/procurement for signature within the week.

— Alice
Alice Chen
Head of Data
Emerald Systems
alice.chen@emeraldsys.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot onramp — request for combined credits + rate carveout

Marissa / Ben / Aditya — forwarding the ask from Emerald. TL;DR: $25k onramp credit + 40% rate concession for first 6 months in exchange for a 12-month $200k commit. Customer will limit the discount to the named model family (Embeddings-Large / GenX-2).

Why I think we should approve:
- High conversion likelihood: technical fit is strong and they have greenlit a dedicated deployment contingent on economics
- Upside: conservative estimate $1.2M ARR if onboarded successfully
- Risk: ~$25k credit + lowered unit economics for 6 months — we remove risk with a minimum commit and model-family restriction

Requested decision:
- Approve the credit + 40% concession under the gating terms below, OR
- Suggest modifications (lower credit, narrower window on the discount, or require stronger minimums)

Gating terms (proposed language to include in SOW):
- One-time $25,000 account credit applied to hosted usage (drawdown allowed over 90 days; credit cannot reduce the minimum committed charge for month 1)
- 40% discounted list rate applied only to Embeddings-Large and GenX-2 for the first 6 months after activation
- 12-month minimum commitment of $200,000 (monthly minimum $16,666.67) to trigger the discount; failure to reach the minimum results in revenue true-up

Attachments: SOW-draft-v2.pdf, pricing-matrix.csv

If you’re good with that I’ll send formal exec approval language to Marissa for signature and loop legal for final SOW edits.

— Vanessa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot onramp — request for combined credits + rate carveout

Vanessa — I’m approving with one modification. I’ve reviewed the pricing-matrix and the commercial impact. I agree this is a strategic account and the proposed terms are within our concession guardrails with one change: reduce the onramp credit to $20k and require that the 12-month minimum be indexed to usage of at least 60% of committed spend in months 4–6 (we want to see adoption before we fully bake in the discount).

Approved concession (final):
- One-time $20,000 onramp credit (drawdown over 90 days; cannot be used to offset month-1 committed minimum)
- 35% discounted list rate for Embeddings-Large and GenX-2 for first 6 months after activation (reduced from 40%)
- 12-month minimum commitment of $200,000 
- Adoption gating: customer must hit >=60% of monthly committed spend in at least two of months 4–6 or the discount is rescinded and revenue true-up occurs

Ben — please update the SOW-draft-v2.pdf and pricing-matrix.csv to reflect these figures. Vanessa — you can push to Alice and procurement and request DocuSign. I’ll loop in legal if they push redlines on the adoption gating language.

— Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial (Sales)
marissa_cole@redwood.com
